title: MPRIS Player
description: A Mod that allows Media Control using MPRIS (Linux Only)
body:
# Purpose

This mod implements commands to control media (e.g. YTMusic or Spotify) within Minecraft using commands. 

# Features

**/pause**
Pauses the current song

**/next**
Skips to next song

**/previous**
Plays the previous song

**/song**
Displays song title, artist and album

**/songtitle**
Displays title of current song

**/artist**
Displays artist of current song

**/album**
Displays album of current song

# Important

This mod only works on Linux as it uses MPRIS
